run_cheetah_environment: run the cheetah benchmarking task by calling run() to create a dm_control Environment
get_cheetah_model_and_assets: get the cheetah MuJoCo model XML string and assets dict via get_model_and_assets()
get_cheetah_physics_speed: get the horizontal speed of the Cheetah by calling Physics.speed() on the physics object
get_cheetah_observation: get an observation dict with position and velocity from Cheetah.get_observation(physics)
get_cheetah_reward: get the running reward for the Cheetah agent via Cheetah.get_reward(physics) using speed tolerance
